name: Cleo
summary: AI money assistant app that analyses spending and offers budgeting, credit and cash-advance features.
description: Cleo is a personal finance app with an AI assistant that analyses spending, comments on habits and helps users budget and save. Subscriptions add credit support, a debt reset plan, cash advances, high-yield savings and early paycheck access.
